source.title: Robonine: Testing of Feetech STS3215 servomotor: backlash, repeatability and torque

independenceNote: Robonine blog test; Robonine sells Feetech-based arm kits.
methodNote: Static load of about 3.5 kg on a 10 cm lever read on a scale, and repeated cycles to a fixed position read on the lever. The post carries no date, so the run is dated when it was read. The post states no uncertainties: ±0.2 N·m and ±2 arcmin are our estimates, not figures from the post.
note: Stall slightly above the 30 kg·cm rating, but long holds tripped overload protection, which cut output to about a fifth.
